book.name: LOS HECHOS
book.title: LOS HECHOS Jesús buerã cʉ̃ja ca tiirique

content: Iconio macãrãre añurije queti cʉ̃ja ca wederique
Iconiore Pablo, Bernabé, cʉ̃ja ca biirucuricarore birora judíos cʉ̃ja ca nea poo juu bueri wiipʉ jãa waari, añurije quetire cʉ̃ ca wedero judíos, judíos ca niitirã, paʉ tʉo nʉnʉjeeupa.
Judíos Jesucristore ca tʉo nʉnʉjeetirã pea, judíos ca niitirãre, Jesucristore ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerã menare cʉ̃ja ca ajiaro cʉ̃jare tiiupa.

To ca bii pacaro, Pablo, Bernabé jãa pea Wiogʉ cʉ̃ ca tii nemorijepʉre tʉgoeña tutuari uwiricaro maniro, toora yoaro añurije quetire wede, tiicã niiupa. Wiogʉ pea, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca mairije maquẽre cʉ̃ja ca wede niirijere, “To birora nii,” cʉ̃jare ĩi majiogʉ, cʉ̃ja jʉoripʉ ca ĩa ñaaña manirije tii bau nii, tii niiupi.
Tii macã macãrã bojoca pea, jĩcãrã judíos cʉ̃ja ca ĩirijere tʉo nʉnʉjee, aperã Pablo jãa cʉ̃ja ca ĩirije peere tʉo nʉnʉjee, ameri bii dica waticã niiupa.
To biri judíos, judíos ca niitirã, cʉ̃jare ca dotirã mena neari, Pablo jãare ʉ̃tã mena dee, ñañaro cʉ̃jare tii, tiirʉgarã, ameri wede peniupa.
Pablo, Bernabé jãa pea teere majiri, Listra, Derbe, Licaonia
yepa macã macãripʉ, to weja ca niiri macãri pee duticoaupa,
añurije quetire to birora cʉ̃ja ca wedecã nʉnʉa waaricaropʉre.
Listrapʉ Pablore ʉ̃tã mena cʉ̃ja ca deerique
Listrare niiupi jĩcʉ̃ ʉmʉ ca waa majitigʉ, upa suquẽro ca baʉaricʉ, waari méé, to birora ca duwi yai waagʉ.
Cʉ̃ pea Pablo cʉ̃ ca wederijere añuro tʉo duwiupi. Pablo pea, “Jesús yʉre catiocãrucumi,” díámacʉ̃ cʉ̃ ca ĩi tʉgoeñarijere ĩa majiri,
tutuaro wederique mena o biro cʉ̃re ĩiupi: —Wãmʉ nʉcã, díámacʉ̃ ea nʉcã waagʉja —ĩiupi. Cʉ̃ pea to biro cʉ̃re cʉ̃ ca ĩirije menara bupu wãmʉ nʉcã, waa jʉo waaupi.
Pablo to biro cʉ̃ ca tiirijere ĩarã, bojoca pea Licaonia macãrã wederique mena o biro ĩi acaro bui jʉo waaupa: —¡Jʉ̃guẽa, bojocare biirã jeeñacãri manire ĩarã duwi doojapa yéé! —ĩi acaro buiupa.
To biri Bernabére cʉ̃ja jʉ̃guẽ Zeus wãmere cʉ̃re wãmeo tii, Pablo peera, bojocare ca wedegʉ cʉ̃ ca niiro macã apĩ cʉ̃ja jʉ̃guẽ Hermes wãmere cʉ̃re wãmeo tii, tiiupa.

Zeus yʉʉ pai, macã piya waarica tabera Zeus're ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉorica wiire ca cʉogʉ pea, wecʉa, oori daari jee dooupi. Cʉ̃ pea cʉ̃ bojoca mena, Pablo jãarire tii nʉcʉ̃ bʉogʉ, wecʉare jĩari joe jʉti añu mʉene nʉcʉ̃ bʉorʉgaupi.
Pablo, Bernabé jãa pea to biro cʉ̃jare cʉ̃ja ca tii nʉcʉ̃ bʉorʉgarijere ĩa majiri, cʉ̃ja jutire yega, bojoca watoara o biro ĩi acaro bui jãa waaupa:

—¿Ñee tiirã atere to biro mʉja tiiti? Jãa cãa, mʉjare birora bojoca jãa nii. Ano añurije queti mʉjare jãa ca wederijea, ate ca wapa manirije mʉja ca tii niirijere tii yerijãari, to birora ca caticõa niigʉ Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ, ati yepare, diare, teepʉre ca niirije niipetirije ca tiiricʉ peere cʉ̃ja tʉo nʉnʉjeejato ĩirã, jãa ca wederije nii.
Ména jʉguero macã cuupʉra, bojoca poogaari cʉ̃ja ca niiro cõrorena cʉ̃ja ca tiirʉgarijere biro cʉ̃ja tiijato ĩicãupi Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ.

To biro bii pacagʉ, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca niirijere ĩñogʉ, añurije tii yerijãatiupi, ʉmʉreco tutipʉ ca niirijere oco tiicojo, yucʉ ca dica cʉtiri yʉteari tii, baarique tiicojo, ñucã yeri ʉjea niirique tiicojo, cʉ̃ ca tii niirije mena —cʉ̃jare ĩiupa.
Ate niipetirije cʉ̃jare cʉ̃ja ca ĩi wederije mena do biro tii majiña maniro ca bii pacaro, cʉ̃jare cʉ̃ja ca tii nʉcʉ̃ bʉorʉgarijere biirique peti cʉ̃jare ĩi camotaupa.

To biro cʉ̃ja ca bii niiri tabere jĩcãrã judíos, Antioquía, Iconio macãrã eari, bojocare cʉ̃ja ca tʉgoeña wajoaro tiiupa. To biri Pablore ʉ̃tã mena dee, “Mee, cʉ̃re mani jĩacãcu” ĩi tʉgoeñari, macã tʉjaropʉ cʉ̃re wee witi waa cõacãupa.
To biro cʉ̃re cʉ̃ja ca tiiro, Jesucristore ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerã pea, cʉ̃re cʉ̃ja ca nea poo amojoderora, cati wãmʉ nʉcã, macã peera piyacoaupi ñucã. Ape rʉmʉra Bernabé mena Derbe macã pee waacoaupi.
Siria yepare ca niiri macã Antioquía pee cʉ̃ja ca tua waarique
Tii macãre añurije quetire wede, paʉ cʉ̃ja ca tʉo nʉnʉjeero tiiri jiro, Listra, Iconio, Antioquía macãrire

Jesucristore ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerãre cʉ̃ja ca tʉgoeña tutuaro tii, “Díámacʉ̃ mʉja ca tʉo nʉcʉ̃ bʉorijere to birora tʉgoeña tutuacõa niiña” cʉ̃jare ĩi, ñucã “Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca doti niiri tabepʉre ea waarʉgarã, ñañaro tamʉoriquera niiro bii,” cʉ̃jare ĩi, ĩi tua waaupa.

Ñucã, Jesucristore ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerã cʉ̃ja ca niiri taberi cõrora, cʉ̃jare ca jʉo niiparãre beje, betirique mena juu bue, Wiogʉ cʉ̃ja ca tʉo nʉnʉjeericʉpʉre cʉ̃jare ĩa nʉnʉjee doti, tii tua waaupa Pablo jãa.
Pisidia yepare ametʉa waarãra, Panfilia yepapʉre eaupa.
Perge macãrãre añurije quetire wede yapano, Atalía macã pee bua waaupa.

Tii macãre bua ea, cũmuapʉ ea jãa, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca mairije quetire ca wedeparã niirucuma ĩigʉ, Añuri Yeri cʉ̃jare cʉ̃ ca jee dica woo dotirica macã Antioquía peera, tee añurije quetire wede yuju yapano, tuacoaupa ñucã.

Antioquíare tua earã, Jesucristore ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerãre neori, niipetirije Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ja mena cʉ̃ ca tiiriquere, ñucã judíos ca niitirã cãa díámacʉ̃ cʉ̃ja ca tʉo nʉnʉjeero cʉ̃ ca tiiriquere, wedeupa.
Tii macãrã Pablo, Bernabé jãa Jesús yee quetire ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerã mena yoaro niicãupa.

footnotes.text: 14.6Licaonia macãrã apeye ca wederã niiupa. Bii pacarã griego cʉ̃ja ca wederijere tʉocãupa.

14.12Zeus, Hermes griegos yaarã jʉ̃guẽa niiupa; romanos pea ñucã cʉ̃jaren Júpiter, Mercurio, cʉ̃jare wãmeo tiiupa. Zeus niiupʉ cʉ̃ja jʉ̃guẽa ca nii majuropeegʉ. Ñucã Hermes pea jʉ̃guẽare queti wede yuju bojari majʉ niiupʉ.
